name: Inno Laser Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Inno Laser Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of lasers and overall solutions in China, the United States, Japan, Germany, South Korea, and internationally. The company offers Diode Pumped Solid State Q-switched nanosecond lasers; ultrashort pulse lasers (picosecond, femtosecond level); and Master Oscillator Power-Amplifier nanosecond lasers. Its products are used in the printed circuit board industry, consumer electronics, semiconductors, photovoltaic, biomedical, new energy, and 3D printing industries.
